content.text: How do you know other people have experiences? You feel your own pain directly, but you only see how others act.

content.definition: Others act and are built like me. When I act that way, I feel pain. So they probably feel pain too.

examples.title: The analogy
lines: When I am hurt, I wince and cry out.
Others wince and cry out when hurt.
examples.conclusion: So others probably feel pain as I do.

examples.title: An objection
lines: The argument rests on one case: my own mind.
examples.note: A generalization from a single case is weak. A robot could also act hurt without feeling anything.

question.prompt: What is the main weakness of the argument from analogy for other minds?
options: Others do not act like us
It rests on a single case, my own mind
question.hint: How many minds can you observe directly?
question.explanation: I observe only one mind directly, my own. Generalizing from one case gives weak support.
